test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word as it is used in the text.**

Palms which cannot __withstand __the drought are confined to the wettest areas or along rivers.
solution: The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'Endure.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's look at the meaning of the underlined word: Word Meaning Withstand to receive without being changed or damaged by something powerful; bear. (किसी शक्तिशाली चीज से बदले या क्षतिग्रस्त हुए बिना प्राप्त करना; सहना) • Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options: Word Meaning Endure to experience and bear something difficult, painful, or unpleasant. (कुछ कठिन, दर्दनाक या अप्रिय अनुभव करना और सहन करना) Convert to (cause something or someone to) change in form or character. ((किसी चीज या किसी के कारण) रूप या चरित्र में परिवर्तन) Undergo to experience something that is unpleasant or something that involves a change. (कुछ ऐसा अनुभव करना जो अप्रिय हो या ऐसा कुछ जिसमें परिवर्तन शामिल हो) Suffer to experience physical or mental pain. (शारीरिक या मानसिक पीड़ा का अनुभव करना) • Clearly, the word 'Endure' is closest in meaning to the given word 'Withstand.' • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.​ 73:T73f, The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'Iynx.'
